title: Auto-accept confident unvoted References after a learned delay; monitor stories draft only from accepted
description: Ryan (owner): (1) papyrus ideas monitor-stories reads only accepted References by default (--status accepted[,pending] overrides). (2) The router accepts a pending Reference automatically when its Cyclotron verdict is positive, its confidence reaches a threshold learned per publication (Wilson 95% lower bound of the editors' accept rate >= target precision), and nobody voted within a delay learned from editor vote latency (q-quantile). Writes curationStatusUpdatedBy auto:cyclotron, never sent to Cyclotron as a human label; the newsroom shows Accepted automatically with an icon. Config autoAccept on router publications; off when absent.
